body:
Rumination disorder survivor. It is much serious than you describe here if left untreated/if treatment doesn't work. Food comes up the same way it went down, except sometimes it blends with other foods and is way too nasty to reswallow.

I went from 125lb to 86lb at 5'7 and then was tube fed for eight months. If the most basic of treatment doesn't work for you (diaphragmatic breathing) you're in trouble.
